subject.title: Docs: avoid generic 600s agent timeout examples

question: Should `openclaw agent` omit the gateway timeout when `--timeout` is absent so the server/runtime default owns the run timeout, despite changing the shipped 600-second implicit cap?
rationale: The source mismatch is clear, but the candidate fix changes an existing fallback that some operators may have relied on without configuring an explicit shorter timeout.

options.title: Accept server-owned omitted timeouts
options.body: Land the linked PR after conflict refresh so docs, CLI help, and gateway dispatch all match the 48-hour runtime default unless users set `--timeout` or config explicitly.

options.title: Preserve the hidden cap for now
options.body: Keep the gateway CLI's shipped 600-second fallback and split only the docs wording until maintainers decide whether the fallback is a supported compatibility contract.

options.title: Document intentional shorter gateway behavior
options.body: If the 600-second cap is intentional for gateway CLI calls, update docs to explain that gateway-backed CLI runs differ from embedded runtime defaults.

recommendation.title: Accept server-owned omitted timeouts
recommendation.body: Land the linked PR after conflict refresh so docs, CLI help, and gateway dispatch all match the 48-hour runtime default unless users set `--timeout` or config explicitly.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision centers on the gateway-backed agent CLI path that git history links to steipete's current-main work.
